affliction_bleed: a single stylized blood-red droplet with a small cut notch and a thin dark contour, like a painted folk charm mark
affliction_slow: a coiled snail-shell spiral made of muted indigo hemp rope, reading instantly as 'slowed'
affliction_poison: a small round onggi jar tipping forward with a curl of moss-green venom smoke rising from its mouth
affliction_shock: a short pale-gold lightning zigzag striking a tiny brass bell
affliction_burn: a compact ember flame shaped like a brushstroke, warm orange with a dark core
affliction_fear: a pale wide-eyed ghost wisp with a small spirit-paper talisman fluttering beside it, eerie but cute
spike_trap: a square straw-bound frame bristling with sharpened bamboo stakes (jukchang) pointing upward, a few iron shard tips
slow_trap: a sagging net of old frayed hemp cloth strips knotted between four short wooden pegs
poison_trap: a half-buried small onggi pot with a woven straw lid slightly open, moss-green venom seeping over the rim and herb leaves tied around it
stun_trap: a bronze-rimmed round plate set with a small brass bell and a folded spirit talisman, pale-gold sparks leaping between them
ember_trap: a shallow clay dish of glowing embers and a cracked dokkaebi-fire shard, small warm flames licking up
fear_trap: a tattered ink-black cloth banner on a crooked stick with a painted staring eye and a pale soul wisp curling around it
thorn_wall: a short straw-bound wall of sharpened bamboo stakes (from the spike trap) with small onggi venom pots (from the poison trap) hung between them, faint moss-green glow
lightning_net: a hemp cloth net (from the slow trap) woven through with brass bells and talisman strips (from the stun trap), pale-gold lightning crawling along the knots, faint glow
wildfire_pit: a shallow pit ringed with sharpened bamboo stakes (from the spike trap) filled with glowing embers and dokkaebi-fire shards (from the ember trap), faint warm glow
dread_gas: a leaning onggi jar (from the poison trap) exhaling a thick moss-green and ink-violet fog in which a pale staring-eye wisp (from the fear trap) floats, faint glow
ember_chain: a length of aged bronze chain whose links hold small ember dishes (from the ember trap) and brass bells with talismans (from the stun trap), sparks and flames alternating, faint glow
quagmire: a dark sucking mud pool edged by a torn hemp net (from the slow trap) with a half-sunk onggi venom pot (from the poison trap) bubbling moss-green, faint glow
hellmouth: a jagged stone maw in the ground framed by bamboo stakes and venom pots (from the thorn wall) with a burning ember pit inside (from the wildfire pit), aged bronze studs and a small crown of violet boss-essence flame
storm_cage: a round cage of bronze bars wrapped in bell-and-talisman netting (from the lightning net) filled with drifting ink-violet dread fog and a staring eye wisp (from the dread gas), crackling pale-gold lightning, violet boss-essence flame on top
plague_tide: a swirling low wave of moss-green bog water (from the quagmire) carrying bamboo stakes and venom pots (from the thorn wall), aged bronze rim, violet boss-essence flame cresting the wave
dokkaebi_fire: a cluster of floating dokkaebi-fire orbs linked by a bronze ember chain (from the ember chain) over a pale fear-fog with a staring eye wisp (from the dread gas), sparks between the orbs, violet boss-essence flame at the heart
